gloss: member (of a team, corps or squad)

definitions.gloss: member (of a team, corps or squad); crew member
definitions.explanation: A member of an organized unit such as a rescue team, an expedition, a squad, or the Self-Defense Forces. Usually attached to the unit's name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{救急隊員|きゅうきゅうたいいん}→救急隊員：22769_kyuukyuutaiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{隊員|たいいん}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: All the team members returned safely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{南極|なんきょく}→南極：11936_nankyoku⟧⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隊員|たいいん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦{基地|きち}→基地：03982_kichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: Members of the Antarctic research expedition live at the base for more than a year.

notes:
⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧ (unit, corps) + {員|いん} (member). The unit usually comes first: {救急|きゅうきゅう}{隊員|たいいん}, ⟦{消防|しょうぼう}→消防：03241_shoubou⟧{隊員|たいいん}, {自衛隊員|じえいたいいん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{救急隊員|きゅうきゅうたいいん}→救急隊員：22769_kyuukyuutaiin⟧: paramedic, ambulance crew member
- ⟦{消防隊員|しょうぼうたいいん}→消防隊員：29793_shouboutaiin⟧: firefighter (on a fire brigade)
- {自衛隊員|じえいたいいん}: member of the Self-Defense Forces
- {捜索隊員|そうさくたいいん}: member of a search party

WATCH OUT:
{隊員|たいいん} sounds the same as ⟦{退院|たいいん}→退院：02090_taiin⟧ (leaving hospital); context tells them apart.
